scope: timesheet-autopilot-0.5 working tree; engineering/evidence judgment, not independently measured AI accuracy

categories.strength: Durable worker is independent of capture, with leases and standing consent.
categories.limitation: Continuous real-desktop and closed-window behaviour is not established.

improvements.description: Detect a missing/stale worker and offer Restart Jev on Today.
improvements.acceptance: Synthetic heartbeat, clock-jump and recovery tests; GTK recovery prompt.

improvements.description: Reject malformed, oversized or wrongly typed whole-day pass metadata.
improvements.acceptance: Corrupt cursor, expiry, identity, range and JSON tests fail closed.

improvements.description: Run a 48-hour native/AppImage/Flatpak recovery trial including closed windows and login.
improvements.acceptance: Record gaps, worker restarts and recovery latency per package/desktop.

categories.strength: Only permitted context is built; generic categories exclude private project names.
categories.limitation: App names cannot establish client identity or distinguish general browsing intent.

improvements.description: Retrieve correction examples by Unicode-normalised app and exact clue/focus scope before limiting.
improvements.acceptance: An older relevant example survives more than 1,000 unrelated corrections.

improvements.description: Offer ready-made task-guidance starters without adding a required setup field.
improvements.acceptance: Optional unsaved starters in the existing task-guidance dialog.

improvements.description: Evaluate shared-browser/client-switch cases with explicitly consented, minimised context.
improvements.acceptance: Compare time-weighted errors and coverage against app-only decisions.

categories.strength: Recorded synthetic replays and full response validation exist.
categories.limitation: Small synthetic samples do not establish representative daily precision.

improvements.description: Add stable case IDs, labelled-input fingerprints, slices and actual model metadata.
improvements.acceptance: Replay output validates unique IDs and separates slice outcomes.

improvements.description: Compare saved candidate/reference responses on identical labelled inputs.
improvements.acceptance: Changed inputs are refused; newly wrong automated cases and coverage deltas are reported.

improvements.description: Collect several independently labelled real days, sampling easy automatic cases as well as exceptions.
improvements.acceptance: Keep private evidence outside the repository; report sample selection and wrong minutes.

categories.strength: Assignments revalidate source evidence and preserve explicit choices; simple drafts are non-billable.
categories.limitation: Routing thresholds remain heuristic and task-level live acceptance is incomplete.

improvements.description: Retain and exercise stale-response, concurrent-edit and explicit-choice protection.
improvements.acceptance: Core race/privacy tests and the independent worker-process check.

improvements.description: Retain rule precedence, no-gap allocation and draft-only AI execution.
improvements.acceptance: Core assignment, rule, undo and daily-choice regressions.

improvements.description: Measure cross-client wrong minutes before broadening task automation.
improvements.acceptance: No financial approval or broader threshold based only on fixture success.

categories.strength: None/ambiguous answers stay for review; generic and project risks have different gates.
categories.limitation: No representative calibration study supports the numeric thresholds.

improvements.description: Use one reusable contract validator outside the worker lifecycle.
improvements.acceptance: Worker, cache and evaluator import the same pure validation module.

improvements.description: Show the saved draft-policy reason and model beside automatic entries.
improvements.acceptance: Inline Why this category? uses saved decision evidence, never a generated justification.

improvements.description: Calibrate abstention and errors separately for specialist apps, browsers and client projects.
improvements.acceptance: Publish sample sizes and time-weighted error/coverage curves before changing gates.

categories.strength: Corrections are scoped local examples, not a claim of model retraining.
categories.limitation: A changed habit may still conflict with remembered history.

improvements.description: Index app/scope retrieval so unrelated history cannot hide relevant examples.
improvements.acceptance: Unicode and >1,000 unrelated-row regression; bounded eight-example lookup.

improvements.description: Order updated corrections by correction time rather than original row ID.
improvements.acceptance: Updating an older correction makes it the first relevant example.

improvements.description: Clear cached decisions and invalidate queued/in-flight jobs when examples are forgotten.
improvements.acceptance: A response arriving after Forget cannot create an entry.

categories.strength: Equivalent payloads reuse durable results; one choice covers an app/day.
categories.limitation: Large synthetic discovery is not a full-day throughput or resource guarantee.

improvements.description: Recheck equivalent clear and ambiguous requests are reused without extra key access.
improvements.acceptance: Whole-day/cache tests preserve request and consent limits.

improvements.description: Make priority-pass persistence robust to malformed and superseded metadata.
improvements.acceptance: Invalid state cannot crash the loop or replace a newer pass.

improvements.description: Add a repeatable disposable large-history benchmark.
improvements.acceptance: 20,000 observations, 20 tasks, five bounded discovery batches recorded locally.

categories.strength: Today exposes missing workers; local counts distinguish queued, uncertain and failed work.
categories.limitation: No validated real-world alert or digest usefulness study exists.

improvements.description: Expose an actionable missing-worker warning instead of a false working claim.
improvements.acceptance: Stale/future/corrupt heartbeats and UI recovery tested.

improvements.description: Expose factual background usage, limits and unresolved charges in simple Settings.
improvements.acceptance: Collapsed local details require no key access or data transmission.

improvements.description: Provide a factual local day digest using observed totals and covered intervals.
improvements.acceptance: Existing record-help expander now summarises recorded, covered, uncategorised and gap time.

categories.strength: Three destinations, one app/day choice, live cards and optional tools are coherent.
categories.limitation: Measured novice completion and review effort remain unavailable.

improvements.description: Retain one daily choice with future same-day reuse and protected existing entries.
improvements.acceptance: Daily-choice and UI tests cover separated periods and direct Assign.

improvements.description: Keep optional day actions expanded through background refreshes.
improvements.acceptance: Found during scaled UI review; More actions now retains its expansion state.

improvements.description: Observe setup-to-saved-day completion and count clicks/repeated questions.
improvements.acceptance: Record task completion, errors and median review minutes with consenting users.

categories.strength: Rules are local, previewable and conservative around conflicting priorities.
categories.limitation: Older entries still lack exact rule identity; novice understanding of rule scope is unverified.

improvements.description: Save rule identity, priority and title-condition flag when a rule allocates time.
improvements.acceptance: Rule explanation survives later rule deletion without duplicating raw title content.

improvements.description: Retain duplicate/conflict/archive/title-availability warnings and previews.
improvements.acceptance: Existing rule core/GTK regressions rechecked.

improvements.description: Test whether novices understand rule scope and future versus historical effects.
improvements.acceptance: Observe a rule creation, deliberate conflict and correction without coaching.

categories.strength: Four click-only steps keep projects, rates and rules optional.
categories.limitation: Account/key acquisition and desktop setup still need real-user validation.

improvements.description: Integrate optional purpose-based project/rule/report shortcuts in the existing fourth step.
improvements.acceptance: Choices stay staged until Start and appear in day actions.

improvements.description: Preserve app exclusions and custom request/token limits when reconnecting.
improvements.acceptance: Excluded eligible activity remains unsent; final disclosure shows saved limits.

improvements.description: Test saved-key, pasted-key, locked-keyring and local-only first runs with novices.
improvements.acceptance: Measure completion and comprehension of the Start consent boundary.

categories.strength: Task guidance and overlapping-definition warnings already exist.
categories.limitation: Generic starters alone cannot distinguish similar client projects.

improvements.description: Offer optional short activity-type starter descriptions.
improvements.acceptance: Choosing a starter only fills the unsaved guidance field.

improvements.description: Retain overlap warnings and explicit bounded focus context.
improvements.acceptance: Profile and focus-boundary regressions; no focus creates time on its own.

improvements.description: Validate competing real project definitions and revise descriptions based on observed confusion.
improvements.acceptance: Use paired shared-app examples; require fewer wrong client minutes, not just more coverage.

categories.strength: App/day grouping avoids repeated per-observation decisions.
categories.limitation: Actual daily effort is not measured; remembered patterns may still repeat across days.

improvements.description: Keep one local answer for separated and later same-day periods.
improvements.acceptance: Grouping, continuation, undo and stale-human-choice tests.

improvements.description: Make operational state/usage visible without opening the advanced automation form.
improvements.acceptance: Collapsed simple Settings details and recovery action.

improvements.description: Measure repeated corrections and review time over at least five consenting-user days.
improvements.acceptance: Separate unresolved, excluded and wrongly allocated minutes; do not optimise only coverage.

categories.strength: Automatic entries now expose saved model, context counts and policy reasons.
categories.limitation: Explanation usefulness and historical policy reproducibility need more evidence.

improvements.description: Provide inline Why this category? for AI and local-rule entries.
improvements.acceptance: Templates use saved evidence and clearly state missing historical detail.

improvements.description: Persist an explicit routing version for new decisions; mark old versions unknown.
improvements.acceptance: Additive migration defaults to zero, not an invented historical version.

improvements.description: State that workflow counts and model scores do not prove accuracy, output or billing approval.
improvements.acceptance: Simple/advanced usage wording and explanations preserve these distinctions.

categories.strength: Edits remain reversible drafts and billed work stays protected.
categories.limitation: Remembered examples are intentionally separate from entry undo.

improvements.description: Preview the actual last action and guard Undo against newer background changes.
improvements.acceptance: Expected change ID is rechecked under the write lock.

improvements.description: Make repository schema checks preserve the caller transaction.
improvements.acceptance: A deliberately rolled-back caller write remains rolled back after Repository construction.

improvements.description: Test correction, Forget and Undo comprehension with real users.
improvements.acceptance: Users must distinguish reverting time from forgetting examples without extra manual setup.

categories.strength: Native buttons/expanders, accessible card labels and scaling checks provide a base.
categories.limitation: No human Orca acceptance or broad assistive-technology evidence exists.

improvements.description: Retain actual mouse/keyboard checks and accessible Assign/card names.
improvements.acceptance: Existing workflows exercise native controls and focus.

improvements.description: Check the changed default flow at normal and 200% scale.
improvements.acceptance: Isolated GTK checks and actual rendered screenshots, not a screen-reader claim.

improvements.description: Run human Orca, keyboard-only and large-text acceptance for setup/review/undo/export.
improvements.acceptance: Record focus order, announced labels, errors and successful task completion.

categories.strength: Capture is independent, records gaps and does not wait for Jev requests.
categories.limitation: Sustained physical desktop/suspend/disk-failure acceptance is incomplete.

improvements.description: Recheck concurrent recording writes during a delayed decision process.
improvements.acceptance: Separate process test verifies durable draft and DB integrity.

improvements.description: Retain explicit away, locked, personal, excluded and unknown intervals.
improvements.acceptance: Capture/privacy tests and factual day-record tests.

improvements.description: Run multi-day suspend/resume, lock/login and disk-exhaustion tests on disposable hardware data.
improvements.acceptance: Compare captured intervals with a reference log; never fill missing time by inference.

categories.strength: Overlap/rate snapshots and draft/billed boundaries are extensively tested.
categories.limitation: Final-package and real-use acceptance of billing/recovery safeguards remains open.

improvements.description: Fix exports subtracting a timer that the export omitted.
improvements.acceptance: The same synthetic day is checked with and without an included running timer.

improvements.description: Make migration checks and Undo concurrency-safe without committing partial changes.
improvements.acceptance: Caller rollback and expected-change regressions.

improvements.description: Recheck non-billable generic AI, protected billing and stale-assignment gates.
improvements.acceptance: Core store, daily-choice, PDF and advanced workflow regressions.

categories.strength: Consent, exclusions, generic-only context and local title reduction are explicit.
categories.limitation: Provider handling is external; backups retain data under their own lifecycle.

improvements.description: Make Forget stop dependent pending/in-flight work and remove cached decisions.
improvements.acceptance: Late completion cannot apply a forgotten-context decision.

improvements.description: Retain existing exclusions and sending caps when simple setup is repeated.
improvements.acceptance: Regression proves an eligible excluded app generates no provider request.

improvements.description: Recheck exports/status/explanations omit raw titles, paths, descriptions and secrets.
improvements.acceptance: Synthetic privacy tests plus source review; permitted local project names remain intentional.

categories.strength: Keys use secure storage; errors are sanitised and unlock failures pause quietly.
categories.limitation: Real keyring/portal/lock diversity is not fully established.

improvements.description: Retain no repeated unlock attempts while the worker is paused.
improvements.acceptance: Key-error regression verifies a single key access and no usage reservation.

improvements.description: Keep new status/explanations/replay/benchmark features independent of key access.
improvements.acceptance: New tools run locally with synthetic data; no real key is read.

improvements.description: Exercise encrypted secret portal and missing-portal behaviour using a private fake service.
improvements.acceptance: Private synthetic portal check; physical desktop unlock acceptance remains separate.

categories.strength: Strict request caps, reported tokens and cache reuse exist.
categories.limitation: The token cap can cross by one request and provider billing remains authoritative.

improvements.description: Keep unresolved usage blocking across midnight, Resume and policy reconfiguration.
improvements.acceptance: A prior-day unknown charge prevents a new request until acknowledged.

improvements.description: Bound daily totals to the actual local calendar day.
improvements.acceptance: Other-day ledger rows cannot distort today's usage totals.

improvements.description: Show request/token limits and unresolved usage across all days in simple Settings.
improvements.acceptance: Factual counts only; no invented currency cost or token estimate.

categories.strength: Queue/backoff/lease handling preserve capture and avoid blind charged retries.
categories.limitation: Prolonged live outage/recovery and provider retirement need acceptance.

improvements.description: Fail closed on corrupt persisted day-pass JSON/types.
improvements.acceptance: Malformed expiry/cursor/identity and oversized/deep JSON tests.

improvements.description: Retain bounded retry and unknown-spend acknowledgement semantics.
improvements.acceptance: Provider rejection, timeout, abandoned lease and budget tests.

improvements.description: Run controlled real-provider outage/auth/model-retirement recovery tests with synthetic prompts.
improvements.acceptance: Record requests/usage/recovery; do not send recorded work or retry unknown charges silently.

categories.strength: Discovery and UI work are bounded; relevant-example lookup is indexed.
categories.limitation: One short synthetic run cannot establish week-long resource behaviour.

improvements.description: Index relevant correction lookup and order by correction time.
improvements.acceptance: App/scope/at index plus large unrelated-history regression.

improvements.description: Provide repeatable bounded discovery timing and RSS evidence.
improvements.acceptance: Disposable synthetic DB; no flaky pass/fail timing threshold.

improvements.description: Run a week-long CPU/RSS/IO/storage profile across realistic retention sizes.
improvements.acceptance: Record machine/package/desktop and latency distributions; set budgets from observations.

categories.strength: Broad deterministic tests now include the newly found failures.
categories.limitation: Synthetic tests do not replace live or human acceptance.

improvements.description: Add adversarial regressions for midnight usage, memory, schema rollback, status, exports and Undo.
improvements.acceptance: New cases reproduce the defects and verify their corrected behaviour.

improvements.description: Add immutable-input offline response comparison and per-slice replay evidence.
improvements.acceptance: Case identity changes are refused; wrong automatic decisions are enumerated.

improvements.description: Run the synthetic discovery benchmark in CI without a machine-specific speed gate.
improvements.acceptance: CI benchmark command added for both existing core OS jobs; final-commit CI execution remains a release gate.

categories.strength: Multiple adapter protocols and virtual X11 paths have checks.
categories.limitation: Actual desktop/package coverage and closed-window Flatpak behaviour remain incomplete.

improvements.description: Recheck virtual X11 capture on an isolated display.
improvements.acceptance: Synthetic virtual display is protocol evidence, not hardware acceptance.

improvements.description: Recheck GNOME and KDE fake-service protocols and privacy boundaries.
improvements.acceptance: Private DBus test services; no real user activity is sent.

improvements.description: Complete a physical GNOME/KDE/Sway/Hyprland and native/AppImage/Flatpak matrix.
improvements.acceptance: Record versions, GPU, permissions, background behaviour and exact failures.

categories.strength: Updates remain read-only and packaging has source/provenance gates.
categories.limitation: This working tree is uncommitted and not a verified public release.

improvements.description: Ignore malformed individual asset names without hiding an otherwise valid release.
improvements.acceptance: A structured invalid name plus valid assets still yields the verified release link.

improvements.description: Validate fresh install, compatible upgrade, backup restore and rollback for final packages.
improvements.acceptance: Use disposable databases and preserve consent, records and key ownership.

improvements.description: Build trusted final-source packages, verify provenance/hashes and publish only those artifacts.
improvements.acceptance: CI/source SHA/public asset digests/local installation must match before claiming delivery.

categories.strength: Policy, memory, validation, status and setup now have clearer boundaries.
categories.limitation: The retained main GTK/store modules are still large.

improvements.description: Extract response validation so evaluation does not depend on worker lifecycle.
improvements.acceptance: Worker and evaluator share the same standalone contract function.

improvements.description: Extract scoped memory and local operational explanations/status.
improvements.acceptance: New modules have direct regression coverage and no key/network requirement.

improvements.description: Extract four-step setup from daily rendering/review.
improvements.acceptance: SetupUI mixin retains the same public UI behaviour and four steps.

categories.strength: Typed results, source fingerprints, ledger and edits are durable.
categories.limitation: Retention intentionally prevents reconstruction of deleted private source detail.

improvements.description: Persist routing version on new decisions and show historical unknowns honestly.
improvements.acceptance: Version zero is unknown; source-deleted decisions do not gain fabricated explanations.

improvements.description: Retain local rule identities without copying raw title evidence.
improvements.acceptance: Rule snapshots survive rule deletion while containing only ID/priority/condition type.

improvements.description: Publish an 84-item machine-readable register with ratings, evidence and acceptance gates.
improvements.acceptance: This report, plan and JSON share the same 28 categories and three actions each.
